facts.fact: Bethany 进 Captain Video、门铃两响、Seth Rogen 样店员
facts.anchor: The bell above the front entrance dings twice

facts.fact: 记忆像 Wikipedia plot summary（不像亲历）
facts.anchor: less something she actually lived through and more like a Wikipedia plot summary

facts.fact: 门上倒写 cryptic text、三色灯绿灭红亮
facts.anchor: One green, one yellow, one red. The green light shuts off at the dinging sound, and the red light immediately turns on.

facts.fact: Davino 死鬼补货、喃喃 The receiver/the future of television、弹孔流血
facts.anchor: The receiver…The receiver…The future of television,

facts.fact: 所有 VHS 盒全空白、店员用表情 backseat drive 她选择
facts.anchor: All of the boxes are blank.

facts.fact: ADULTS ONLY 天鹅绒帘、三色灯黄灭绿亮、docility 驱动她跟随
facts.anchor: so she tucks her VHS case into the waistband of her jeans

facts.fact: 矿车轨道通向地下洞穴；她带 popcorn 和空白带坐进去
facts.anchor: a minecart parked a few feet ahead of her

facts.fact: 巨型透明 cylinder 里的全部电视史
facts.anchor: Inside the cylinder is television. All of television history

facts.anchor: The resolution keeps degrading the farther down Bethany travels

facts.fact: 吃 stale popcorn、确认 VHS 带在腰间、And finally she arrives
